response.sql:
WITH per_media AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms,
       AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count
FROM per_media;

assumptions.assumption: The database is SQLite, so NULL Bytes rows fail the >= filter and are excluded, and a zero Milliseconds value makes the division return NULL, which AVG skips.
Track counts include every qualifying track in each media type, including any with Milliseconds = 0, since only the bytes-per-millisecond average skips those rows.
